references.text: The Lord warned Pharaoh that the swarms of flies would come if he did not let the people go
Parallel verses describing the distinction between Egypt and Goshen during this plague
The psalmist recalls how God sent swarms of flies that devoured the Egyptians
The psalm tells how God spoke, and swarms of flies came over all the land of Egypt
A similar pattern where the plague fills Pharaoh's house and the houses of his servants throughout Egypt
The Lord's hand comes upon Egypt with another plague, showing the same pattern of judgment
Complementary account of the same plague: 8:20 shows the introduction and destruction, while 8:27 confirms God's complete control by removing the plagues entirely.
Theological summary: 8:20 is a concrete elaboration of the 'great signs' mentioned in Deut 6:22.
